artboards.title: Files — a row under the pointer

annotations.text:
The tree indents by exactly one icon column.

Row icons are 24px — the rows are bare <button>s, so shadcn's [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 never reaches them. With 8px row padding and an 8px gap, a folder icon starts at 40px, so the child container is offset 32 (20px margin, 1px guide, 11px padding) and a child row's own padding lands its first icon at 40 too.

That is what puts a subfolder's chevron and a document's file icon under the folder they belong to. Documents get no extra spacer.

The whole row is one hover target, menu included.

A ring plus a light fill, and a pointer cursor — a bare <button> gets cursor:default from preflight, so nothing said a document opened on click.

The overflow button is opacity-0 until the row is hovered or something inside it takes focus. Opacity rather than hidden: it keeps its place so rows never change width, and stays focusable so a keyboard can still reach it.

A folder gives way to its document only when the document is named after it.

onlyDocument() asks the same question ownsItsFolder() does. Without the name check the collapse cascaded: Book/Chapters/One.md surfaced One at the root with both folders gone, and a folder the writer had just made vanished the moment writing was filed into it.

Every other folder keeps its row, including an empty one — which is very often one just made from this screen.

Delete folder is offered only on a folder the scan found empty, and it confirms first.

The browser is what actually enforces the safety: removeEntry(name) without recursive:true is refused when the directory is not empty, so a folder holding writing cannot be removed here even if the tree is out of date. deleteDocument passes recursive:true on purpose, because a folder-document's folder IS the document.

The confirm step is CLAUDE.md's rule — every destructive filesystem operation asks first — kept rather than carved out.

A document created from a folder row is named before it is made, and written straight away as a file-document inside that folder.

That is the second shape the app creates. The editor's New document still stays in memory until its first save and still lands as a top-level folder-document; CLAUDE.md now says both.

The extension is always .md — what the app creates — where a file it merely opened keeps whatever it arrived with. A duplicate name is refused before the write, never worked around after it.
